name: evalkit
description: Evaluate and compare skills and models with static reviews and worktree-isolated coding-task harnesses. Host-adaptive across Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate and compare skills and models
interface.longDescription: Review skill authoring quality statically, or measure real coding-task outcomes by running the same task under isolated git worktrees while varying one factor: a skill's presence, one skill versus another, or one model versus another. The dynamic harnesses are host-adaptive — they detect the current agent host and drive either Claude Code (claude -p) or GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot -p), parsing each host's telemetry and reporting its native metrics. Bundles a host-agnostic skill-reviewer agent so the static skills are self-contained. Includes a worktree cleanup skill for the harness leftovers.
defaultPrompt: Review the authoring quality of this skill.
